mapper.select:
SELECT CUS_AWARD_ID as cusAwardId, ACTIVITY_ID as avivityId, AWARD_ID as awardId, OPENID as openId, GET_STATE as getState, CUSTOMER_IP as customerIp, AWARD_FROM as awardFrom, CREATED_BY as createdBy, CREATED_DATE as createdDate, UPDATED_BY as updateBy, UPDATED_DATE as updateDate, REMARK as remark FROM CMWA_WX_ACT_CUSTOMER_AWARD T WHERE T.OPENID = #{openId}
AND T.CREATED_DATE > TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND T.CREATED_DATE < TRUNC(SYSDATE + 1) AND T.AWARD_FROM = '0' ORDER BY CREATED_DATE DESC
select * from cmwa_wx_act_customer_award t where t.cus_award_id = #{cusAwardId} and t.openid = #{openId}

select t2.award_name as awardName, t1.nickname, 0 as msgType, '' as otherUserName, case when award_source = 'TONGBOX' then '铜宝箱' when award_source = 'YINBOX' then '银宝箱' when award_source = 'JINBOX' then '金宝箱' end as awardSource from cmwa_wx_user_info t1, (select rownum rw, page.openid, page.award_name,t1.award_name as award_source from (select t.openid, t1.award_name, t1.award_pid as award_id from cmwa_wx_act_customer_award t, cmwa_wx_act_award_info t1 where t.award_id = t1.award_id and (t1.award_type = '1' or t1.award_type = '0') order by t.created_date desc) page, Cmwa_Wx_Act_Award_Info t1 where t1.award_id = page.award_id and rownum <= 10) t2 where t1.openid = t2.openid union all select '' as awardName, t4.nickname as nickname, 1 as msgType, t5.nickname as otherUserName, '' as awardSource from (select t.*, rownum rw from (SELECT * FROM cmwa_wx_act_share_info t order by t.created_date) t where rownum <= 10) t3 INNER JOIN cmwa_wx_user_info t4 ON t3.openid = t4.openid INNER JOIN cmwa_wx_user_info t5 ON t3.FROM_OPENID = t5.openid

select CONFIG_ID as CONFIGID, ACTIVITY_ID as ACTIVITYID, SHARE_TITLE as SHARETITLE, SHARE_IMGURL as SHAREIMGURL, SHARE_DESC as SHAREDESC, SHARE_LINK as SHARELINK, CREATED_BY as CREATEDBY, CREATED_DATE as CREATEDDATE, UPDATED_BY as UPDATEDBY, CREATED_DATE as UPDATEDDATE, REMARK , CHANNEL from CMWA_WX_ACT_SHARE_CONF t where t.ACTIVITY_ID =#{activityId} and t.CHANNEL=#{channel}

SELECT T.SHARE_ID AS shareId, T.ACTIVITY_ID AS activityId, T.FROM_OPENID AS fromOpenid, T.OPENID AS openId FROM CMWA_WX_ACT_SHARE_INFO T WHERE T.ACTIVITY_ID = #{activityId} AND T.FROM_OPENID = #{openId} AND ROWNUM =1
